text: I'm really sorry to message so late, I might be worrying over nothing. My stepdaughter is 2 months old and her temp was 39.1. When the medicine kicks in she's playing and feeding well and chatty, cooing at us. But I think her cry sounds different, kind of weak and high and it just goes on and on, not her normal cry at all. Her mum thinks so too I think. Sorry, just didn't know if that matters
